T: Death's still hungry. So are we.
D: A year after Flight 180, a young woman's vision saves a group of strangers on the highway, and death starts working back through the list.
P: Serve the pretzel bites when Kimberly and her friends set off on their spring break road trip.
S: packed for the spring break drive to Daytona

Heat the oven to 220C and line a tray with baking paper. Roll the dough into 4 long ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Bring the water and bicarb to the boil and boil the bites for 30 seconds in batches, then drain. Lay on the tray, brush with egg and sprinkle with the salt. Bake until deep brown. Mix the mustard, honey and mayonnaise and serve with the warm bites.
lined up neatly in order, just like the list

Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes. Cool in iced water. Peel, halve lengthways and scoop the yolks into a bowl. Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar and salt until smooth and pipe back into the whites. Dust with the paprika and scatter with chives.
M: a big night in for the lottery winner in his new apartment

Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the beef and pork mince, egg, parmesan for the meatballs, the crushed garlic and half the salt. Roll into 20 balls. Brown the meatballs in the oil in a wide pan and lift out. Soften the onion and sauce garlic in the pan, add the passata, the basil stalks and the rest of the salt, return the meatballs and simmer. Meanwhile cook 400g spaghetti in well salted boiling water until al dente and drain. Toss the spaghetti with a little sauce, top with the meatballs, torn basil leaves and the parmesan for serving.
W: the trip was meant to end on a Florida beach

Heat the oven to 170C. Mix the biscuit crumbs with the butter and press into a 23cm pie tin. Bake the base. Whisk the condensed milk, egg yolks, lime zest and 150ml lime juice until smooth. Pour into the base and bake until just set. Cool, then chill. Whip the cream with the icing sugar and spread over the pie.
K: for the beach Kimberly and her friends were headed for
Stir the rum, pineapple juice, orange juice and lime juice in a jug. Chill. Pour over ice in 4 tall glasses, drizzle in the grenadine so it sinks and add an orange slice.
